description: Committee recommends regulating new building energy standards to Tier 2.
Tier 2 improves energy performance 10%, saving $300 annually.
This aligns with city's Low Emissions Community plan.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Home builders' CEO reported members are split, with 60-70% supporting Tier 1 and 30-40% Tier 2.
Builders face higher upfront costs and potential delays from blower door tests.
Home Builders' Association raised concerns about costs, affordability, and inconsistent regulations.
Affordability concerns raised for builders focused on delivering attainable housing.
Tier 2 aligns with the city's goal of net-zero new home construction by 2036.

speakers.name: Nicole Burgess
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Energy Regulation Options for Building Standards
said: Many builders voluntarily met Tier 2 before it was required.
Tier 2 adds costs and delays from required blower door tests.
Builders need certainty, collaboration, and a level playing field.
